name: Boughton Farm
tagline: Member Spotlight: Boughton Farm • Summit County Farm Bureau
description: Boughton Farm is an agritourism farm in 256 Boughton Drive, OH, open to visitors for seasonal picking and farm activities. Offerings follow the growing season, so what is available changes through the year. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
